name: Additional Recipients
description: The power may affect more than one target for 1 additional Power Point each.

name: Damage
description: The barrier causes 2d4 damage to anyone who contacts it.

name: Hardened
description: The wall is Hardness 12.

name: Shaped
description: The barrier forms a circle, square or other basic shape.

name: Size
description: The length and height of the barrier doubles.

name: Mind Rider
description: The caster can communicate and sense through any of the beasts he's befriended.

name: Area of Effect
description: The caster can focus the blast to a Small Blast Template for no extra cost, or a Large Blast Template for +1.

name: Damage
description: The power causes 3d6 damage (4d6 with a raise).

name: Area of Effect
description: For +2 points the power affects everyone in a Medium Blast Template. For +3 points the area of effect is increased to a Large Blast Template.

name: Strong
description: The roll to shake off the effect is made at -2.

name: Power
description: The caster can burrow through stone, concrete, or similar substances. (Some substances, like plastic, glass, solid lead, etc., might be resistant at the GM's discretion.)

name: Damage
description: The damage field causes 2d6 damage.

name: Area of Effect
description: The power affects everything in a sphere the size of a Medium Blast Template for +1 points, or a Large Blast Template for +2.

name: Strong
description: Detection rolls to see through the concealment are made at -2.

name: Size
description: The recipient may assume the shape of someone up to two Sizes larger or smaller than themselves.

name: Power
description: Dispel can disrupt enchanted devices for one round, or two with a raise. The difficulty to do so is -2 for permanently enchanted items such as found in most swords & sorcery campaigns, or -4 for divine or legendary relics.

name: Strong
description: The entangling material is particularly resilient. Rolls to break free are made at -2 and its Toughness increases to 7.

name: Additional Recipients
description: The power may affect more than one target for 2 additional Power Point each.

name: Area Effect
description: The power affects a Large Blast Template.

name: Greater Healing
description: Greater healing can restore any Wound, including those more than an hour old.

name: Crippling Injuries
description: The power can heal a permanent Crippling Injury. This requires an hour of preparation and only one  casting is permitted per injury. If it fails, this caster cannot heal that particuar injury (but someone else may try). If successful, the subject is Exhausted for 24 hours.

name: Neutralize Poison or Disease
description: A successful healing roll negates any poison or disease. If the poison or disease has a bonus or penalty associated with it, the modifier applies to the arcane skill roll as well.

name: Sound
description: The power generates sound appropiate fo the illusion. Illusionary allies may talk, illusionary crows caw, and so on. It may not mask or mute existing sound, however.

name: Strong
description: Smarts rolls to disbelieve the illusion are made at -2.

name: Additional Recipients
description: The power may affect more than one target for 3 additional Power Point each.

name: Mobile
description: The caster can move the area of effect up to his arcane skill die type each round after casting, or attach it to an inanimate object when first cast.

name: Edit
description: Instead of wiping the memory, the caster edits it as she sees fit instead.

name: Fast Cast
description: The caster can wipe a memory as an action.

name: Audible History
description: The caster can now hear sounds and conversations as well.

name: More Armor
description: Success grants 4 points of Armor (+6 with a raise).

name: Toughness
description: Protection provides Toughness instead of Armor and is not affected by AP (magical or otherwise). This means it stacks with natural or worn armor.

name: Power
description: The hero can raise a spirit dead up to a decade.

name: Speech
description: The recipient retains the power of speech.

name: Quickness
description: Speed only. The character's total Multi-Action penalty each turn is reduced by 2 (she can do two actions at no penalty or three at -2 each).

name: Targeted
description: Instead of casting the power in an area of effect, the caster may instead target individuals in Range for 1 Power Point each. Each victim resists with Spirit (at -2 if the power is activated with a raise).

name: Bite/Claw
description: The ally can bite or claw at Str+d6.

name: Flight
description: The ally can fly at Pace 12.

name: Mind Rider
description: The caster can communicate and sense through the ally.

name: Teleport Foe
description: Foes may be targeted by a Touch attack. This is an action, so the casting must be the second part of a Multi-Action if the attack is successful. The foe resists the casting with an opposed Spirit roll againstthe arcane skill total and is sent up to 12" away with success and 24" with a raise. Foes may not be teleported into solid objects.

name: Additional Zombies
description: A larger horde can be raised in a single casting by paying 1 Power Point for each extra zombie raised.

name: Armed
description:
The dead rise with a rusting weapon common to their setting and enviroment. Choose one:
• Hand Weapon: Str+d6.
•Ranged Weapon: Range 12/24/48, Damage 2d6.

name: Armor
description: The horrors crawl from their grave wearing 2 points of Armor. This might be old chain mail, rusting plate, rotting bulletproof vests, etc.

name: Mind Rider
description: The caster can communicate and sense through one of the undead he's conjured. If it's destroyed, he may jump to any of the others currently under his control.

name: Permanent
description: The zombie is given unlife until destroyed (Incapacitated by Wounds). This has no additional cost, but the Power Points used to raise it are invested and unavailable until it's destroyed. The necromancer who raised it may terminate its unlife at any time.
